notes.title: Ultimate ADOM is now fully released on Steam along with Massive Content Update!
notes.content:
Together with developer [i][b]Team ADOM[/b][/i] we are excited to announce that [b]Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos[/b] — the classic-meets-modern hardcore roguelike — is available today for Windows PC, Mac, and Linux via Steam. 
[b]And that’s not all! [/b]
The title also today receives the [b]“​Update of the Living Dead”[/b], which includes a brand new class — [b]the Necromancer[/b] — along with three new magical skill trees, for a total of 68 new skills, 19 new spells, and more than 20 new monsters to slay!

[h3]Exclusive 30% off Launch-Discount[/h3]
Get Ultimate ADOM now and get an exclusive 30% off launch-discount on both the Standard- and Save The World Edition:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266820/Ultimate_ADOM__Caverns_of_Chaos/

[h3]Full Changelog for the 'Update of the Living Dead':[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1266820/view/2949282018089350376

[h3]Overview features of the 'Update of the Living Dead':[/h3]
[i]"You have my sword." -Adventurer "And you have my Bow" -Archer "And my Axe" -Fighter "And your (un)dead fellow fighting alongside you!" -Necromancer[/i]
[list][*] [u][b]The Necromancer Class:[/b][/u] A master of death magic and grafting, the Necromancer can utilize the dark powers of Lichcraft to transform himself into a powerful undead beast. 
[*] [u][b]68 new Skills, 19 new Spells:[/b][/u] The addition of three new skill trees — Death Mastery, Summoning Evil Spirits, and Death Magic — opens up whole new approaches to combat.
[*] [u][b]20 New Monsters:[/b][/u] New beasts to slay are now present across all levels, including the Kobold Wizards who can learn all the spells you know.
[*] [u][b]Factions Now Reward Loyalty:[/b][/u] Each faction now provides unique starting equipment and stat boosts, and playing for the same faction repeatedly will grant powerful boons.
[*] [u][b]Custom Characters:[/b][/u] Players can now fully customize their character’s appearance, as well as the inventory screen and how items appear on the ground.
[*] [u][b]And Much More:[/b][/u] The new update comes with visual enhancements to spells, biomes, and wall decorations, better scaling for spells at high levels, and plenty of re-balancing, UI improvements, bug fixes and stability improvements.[/list]

[h3]Watch the Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos full release trailer here: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=jxgK8I_0Kus;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Ultimate ADOM Release-Livestream on Twitch![/h3]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838297/51ad1c193ba11295dcdb297a0270c54d79c8eba4.jpg[/img][/url]
To celebrate the full release of Ultimate ADOM, Assemble's Uwe will livestream the full release version, giving you a glimpse of what the game looks like and the new Necromancer class!
Tune in starting at 2pm CEST/5am PT/8am ET on:
[list][*] [b]Our official Twitch-channel:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment]https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment[/url]
[*] [b]Our official YouTube-channel:[/b] [url=https://youtu.be/656fqj2Ey0Y]https://youtu.be/656fqj2Ey0Y[/url][/list]


[h3]About Ultimate ADOM[/h3]
A sequel 25 years in the making, Ultimate ADOM takes everything players love about traditional roguelikes — procedurally generated levels, random encounters, tons of skills, and a ridiculous amount of build varieties and play styles — and adds in modern sensibilities like multiple graphics options, intuitive controls, and a slick presentation.

Since the events of the first game, the big bad known as Andor Drakon has been seemingly vanquished and Ancardia is still struggling with the cataclysmic aftermath of Andor’s defeat. Unfortunately, power abhors a vacuum, and seven factions are now scrambling to be the new top dog. While they bicker with each other, however, a new evil begins to stir below the surface. It’s up to you to head down into the aptly named Caverns of Chaos to investigate these ominous rumblings and keep things from getting out of hand. Dust off your spellbook, grab your favorite cloak, and maybe graft a new arm to your body so you can hold another weapon — you’re going to need it.

[h3]Key Features of Ultimate ADOM Include: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Every Run is Different:[/b] Thanks to a staggering variety of skills, spells, classes, and factions, players can enjoy the challenge of Ultimate ADOM with a nearly-endless selection of build combinations.
[*] [b]Read the Limb Loaning Agreement:[/b] Let nothing go to waste! Collect the severed body parts of your defeated foes and graft them onto your own body. As the old saying goes, two heads are better than one — especially when they’re attached to the same body!
[*] [b]Multiple Methods for Magic Mastery:[/b] Swords are fun, but summoning demons, flinging balls of fiery death or animating the very walls of the dungeon to crush your enemies is even better.
[*] [b]Keep Things Old School:[/b] Hardcore genre purists will be pleased to know that Ultimate ADOM can be played in classic ASCII format, and can even toggle between 3D mode and top-down view.[/list]

[h3]Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos is now available on Windows PC, Mac, and Linux via Steam.[/h3]
The game is currently available in English, German, French, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. For more on the game and the development progress, visit the official site at https://www.ultimate-adom.com 


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266820/Ultimate_ADOM__Caverns_of_Chaos/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838297/32107d86d3df499f4cceb442834e90663c37c265.jpg[/img][/url]

Assemble Entertainment is also offering a “Save the World” Edition for Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos that contains bonus wallpapers and the original soundtrack! 
In keeping with the game’s theme of battling corruption, for every “Save the World Edition" sold, Assemble will donate 10% of the proceeds to the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).

Join us in the battle against cancer and contribute your share to save the world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266820/Ultimate_ADOM__Caverns_of_Chaos/

notes.title: Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos entering Steam Early Access February 11, 2021!
notes.content:
Together with developer Team ADOM, we at Assemble Entertainment announced today the rogue-like dungeon crawler Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos, heading to Steam Early Access on February 11, 2021, for Windows PC, MacOS, and Linux. 

Ultimate ADOM is a traditionally-inspired reimaging of the beloved genre and features endless procedurally generated dungeons, monsters, and crafting options, allowing for ultimate replayability. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266820/Ultimate_ADOM__Caverns_of_Chaos/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838297/a05af5a841d8e386090ee2832073dd0d99afae3f.png[/img][/url]

Evil has been vanquished. Peace has returned to Ancardia, and the peasants dare to dream once more of prosperity. Seven very different factions vie for control over the cataclysmic aftermath left behind by Andor Drakon’s defeat. And somewhere, deep down in an inhospitable cave, chaos is stirring again. Pick up your blade, prepare your spells, check your daggers and ready your bow, for you are about to enter the ominous Caverns of Chaos. Choose your allegiance carefully, for you are nothing more than an expendable asset to the masters you choose.

Fight for a mercenary's glory and a hefty coin purse, for the justice of a community in decline, for the light of purity, or even for chaos itself. Every choice you make will determine how you approach the ever-changing Caverns of Chaos laid out before you.


[i]“To be the person who originated a game with an active and dedicated community since 1994 makes me unbelievably proud,"[/i] said Thomas Biskup, Creator of ADOM. [i]"After 25 years we will continue the story of ADOM and bring that experience into the modern realm. Ultimate ADOM: Caverns of Chaos offers plenty of depth for seasoned vets of the genre but with all the tweaks, options, and quality of life adjustments that ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience for the contemporary player.”[/i]

[h3]Watch the Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos announcement trailer: [/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yhkALyxe_kY

[h3]Features of Ultimate ADOM Include:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Depth for Days[/b] — Choose from a huge selection of classes, genders, races, and allegiances to mix and match the perfect build for your playstyle
[*] [b]A Proper Roguelike[/b] — Procedurally generated levels, monsters, and items ensure no playthrough is the same
[*] [b]More Spells Than a Hogwarts Textbook[/b] — With multiple specialized schools of magic and more than 100 spells to choose from, dungeon-diving wizards have plenty at their disposal to get them through the darkness
[*] [b]That’s a Nice Arm You’ve Got There...[/b] — Take the severed limbs of your enemies and graft them to your own body, after all, more hands = more weapons to hold
[*] [b]A Jack of All Trades[/b] — With more than 80 skill trees, aspiring dungeon delvers have plenty of choices when it comes to crafting the ultimate warrior, and then there are the dozens of secret skills waiting to be discovered!
[*] [b]Go Modern or Keep it Classic[/b] — Modern graphics or traditional ASCII, the choice is yours! Players can also toggle between 3D mode and top-down view.[/list]

To learn more about Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos and add the game to your wishlist, visit the official Steam store page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266820/Ultimate_ADOM__Caverns_of_Chaos/

[h2]Ultimate ADOM Early Access will launch on Windows PC, MacOS, and Linux via Steam on February 11, 2021! [/h2]

notes.title: Kickstarter Announcement: ADOM the Roleplaying game
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today I have an ADOM-related announcement! 
ADOM is branching out into new media: 
Our [b]Kickstarter campaign for the ADOM pen & paper roleplaying game[/b] now is live: [url=https://www.adom.de/rpg-kickstarter]https://www.adom.de/rpg-kickstarter[/url]

You can find more information about the RPG at [url=https://www.adom-rpg.com/samples]https://www.adom-rpg.com[/url] (and take time to look at our beautiful samples at [url=https://www.adom-rpg.com/samples]https://www.adom-rpg.com/samples[/url] - I'm really excited about the look of the game).

This is really exciting for the current ADOM game, too, for several reasons (besides broadening the audience):
[list]
[*] Design work currently happening for ADOM RPG will affect the development of Ultimate ADOM (and on the very high backer levels you even can have a direct hand in this).
[*] Some of the design ideas in the ADOM RPG (e.g. racial powers growing over time with increasing levels; revised class powers) eventually will make their way back into ADOM to improve the ADOM gameplay.
[*] You will finally be able to play ADOM as a pen & paper RPG with a much more complete, modern and very fast & furious ruleset (compared to the limited ADOM Lite edition we released a couple of years ago - this is a completely new design from the ground up) 
[/list]
You can find some more information on features that might make its way into future ADOM releases here:

https://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2019/01/adom-rpg-kickstarter-now-live.html

Please help us to spread the word - during our 2012 crowdfunding campaign learned that it is extremely difficult to reach all interested people. Every share, line and repost on your social channels helps a lot, even if you decide not to donate!

Thanks so much!

Thomas Biskup
ADOM Creator & Maintainer

P.S.: We haven't stopped on working on ADOM due to the Kickstarter - the next ADOM release will happen before the end of the Kickstarter.

notes.title: ADOM 3.0.5 now public: The most complete ADOM ever
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

One day before Christmas we are very proud to release ADOM 3.0.5 to the general Steam public. ADOM 3.0.5 is the culmination of the crowdfunding campaign started in 2012 (http://www.indiegogo.com/resurrect-adom-development).

ADOM 3.0.5 consists of a spectacular set of features including:
[list]
[*] extensive character generation options including 12 races and 22 classes, point-based atttribute generation and a lot more,
[*] extensive game customization options (permadeath versus save & load, monster lethality, treasure rates, etc.) to truly create your preferred way of playing ADOM,
[*] several hundred dungeon levels to explore,
[*] more than three dozen specific quests during the main quest,
[*] various play modes (tutorial, standard, roguelike, challenge, network, customized, etc.),
[*] 140 exciting unique artifacts,
[*] 480 monsters, 896 base items, 47 spells, 41 skills, 100 talents, 
[*] a large number of (fair and meaningful) achievements, 
[*] a global highscore server at http://rogueleague.org (see http://rogueleague.org/register to learn how to register),
[*] a simple and easy to use UI with extensive tooltips, hints and a detailed tutorial mode.
[*] and so much more.
[/list]

Please note that this will not end ADOM development. Quite to the contrary we have an almost infinite amount of ideas and improvements to continue ADOM development. As a consequence you can expect new releases for years to come. Nonetheless we are very proud about finally finishing our 2012 crowdfunding campaign.

We wish you a Merry Christmas. And now go and enjoy ADOM - the current sale is the best you can get, so buy some more ADOM codes as Christmas gifts and give them to your friends and loved ones :-) !

Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM 3.0.5 now available as a public Steam beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are very close now to a general public release: You already can try out ADOM 3.0.5 as a public Steam beta. Here you can find a description about how to activate it: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/p/adom-beta-steam.html

ADOM 3.0.5 is a _huge_ update compared to the last Steam release 2.3.8. It contains a significant amount of new content, the most important features being:

[list]
[*] dozens of new items
[*] 50+ new artifacts
[*] dozens of new monsters
[*] 3 new community quests, 4 new mini maps, the legendary volcano quest, the quest for Rolf, forefather of dwarves and various other special quests
[*] many dozens of new items
[*] a completely revised and better integrated online manual
[*] a global online highscore server at http://roguelike.org which allows you to compare your skill to players all over the world; especially the challenge mode will benefit from this as we now can compare our skill week by week
[*] 100+ bug fixes and refined features.
[/list]

Detailed descriptions are available here:

[list]
[*] the the changelog: http://www.adom.de/home/changelog.html
[*] for ADOM 3.0.0: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/11/adom-300-released-as-prerelease-test.html 
[*] for ADOM 3.0.1: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/11/announcing-adom-301-for-prerelease.html
[*] for ADOM 3.0.2: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/11/adom-302-released-to-our-prerelease.html
[*] for ADOM 3.0.3: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/12/adom-303-prerelease-now-available.html
[*] for ADOM 3.0.4: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/12/adom-304-prerelease-and-rogueleagueorg.html
[*] for ADOM 3.0.5: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/12/announcing-adom-305-as-prerelease.html
[/list]

Enjoy the beta and let us know if you find things that misbehave. Extensive testing has been done so we are very optimistic about the stability of the release - and intend to make it generally available very soon.

Axes high!
Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM 2.3.6 released to Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are very proud to announce the release of ADOM 2.3.6 as a full Steam release.

Despite the rather minor version bum from 2.3.5 to 2.3.6 you will find a ton of enhancements in this release - we have added 80+ refinements to the user interface alone, several races and classes have been buffed, lots of bugs have been fixed, there are performance improvements, lots of additions to make ADOM even easier to play, etc. pp.

You can find an extensive change log at http://www.adom.de/home/changelog.html

Next steps now are
[list]
[*] new images and videos for Steam to show the vastly improved UI,
[*] completing the crowdfunding promises,
[*] releasing a lot more often!
[/list]

Please read the detailed release notes at http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/10/full-steam-release-adom-236-is-here.html

[b]Now is the perfect time to get into ADOM (or try it once more if you didn't like it in the past as so much has changed) because you can get it at the lowest possible price during the ongoing Halloween sale (we are not going to discount more than 10%)![/b]

Kind regards
Thomas & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM 2.3.5 now available to all Steam players!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I am very proud to announce the release of ADOM 2.3.5 as a Steam Beta to the general public. The process to access the ADOM 2.3.5 beta is described here: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/p/adom-beta-steam.html

The general public release hopefully will follow very soon - we just want to get feedback on stability, first impressions, etc. for a couple of days before it will be launched.

Note that ADOM 2.3.5 still is a beta version - there might be bugs, crashes, etc. that we didn't discover in our tests. So be prepared for a little bumpiness - experience has taught us that general public releases are very different from prerelease test releases, which in turn yield a very different experience to our local tests.

ADOM 2.3.5 is the culmination of more than a year of development (one year and one day exactly today - our last release was ADOM 2.2.6 on October, 16th, 2016). 

ADOM 2.3.5 contains tons of new stuff. I just want to give you a few highlights:
[list]
[*] A new, much more beautiful and much more functional HUD.
[*] Tons of graphical tweaks (like mostly animated monsters, speech bubbles, quick hints, dialog boxes, etc.)
[*] Tons of usability enhancements (quick hints, better context menus, more graphical mouse cursors, finally ESC support, a better quest status screen, many improved dialogs, etc. pp.)
[*] Tons of new content (117 new items, 22 new monsters, Rolf Quest, Volcano Quest, rechargeable items as a while new item category, ...)
[*] A new "easy" game mode (that doesn't take away any content or fun but serves as a better game mode for new ADOM players - the game will try to kill you a little less often ;-) )
[/list]

Read all the details here:
http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/10/adom-235-released-as-steam-beta.html

And now enjoy the latest version and let us know what you think!

If you find bugs or have ideas for more improvements please submit them at http://www.adom.de/bugs

We now are back to working and ADOM 2.3.6 and ADOM 2.4.0 and will be active a lot more often from now on. 

Kind regards
Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: Update on current activities
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'd like to give a quick update on current activities:

We are moving forward with development but the number of loose ends is still staggering. We are very close now to an ASCII test release and hopefully also will be able to do a Steam beta shortly afterwards. These blog posts point to a few of the new features:

http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/08/physical-crowdfunding-rewards-revised.html mentioning
- the new HUD prototype
- big improvements on scaling ADOM for various resolutions
- the revised talent screen

http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/08/quick-hints-quest-dialogs.html mentioning
- a new quick hint system that greatly simplifies learning the key commands
- the revised quest system with much better messages and statusses
- improved mouse handling

http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/08/most-bigly-adom-news-update-in-long.html mentioning
- the revision of point-based character generation
- changes to question-based attribute generation
- the new configuration screens for ADOM
- many details on the physical rewards from the crowdfunding campaign


Lots of work also happened on physical rewards for people who donated during the crowdfunding campaign. Some details can be found here: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/08/physical-crowdfunding-rewards-revised.html

Additionally the _final_ roll call for submitting your addresses for physical shipments is up: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2017/08/final-roll-call-physical-adom.html

Act now!

That's it for today.

Stay tuned - I hope that the next announcement will be the Steam beta ;-)

Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: Current work in progress: character generation & lots of graphics
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'd just like to give a quick update about the stuff we are right now working on: In our current development version we 

1. have a totally flexible and rewritten character generation process including point-based attribute distribution, star sign selection, complete configurability, re-use of previous selections and much more. After some testing and graphical enhancements it quickly will find its way into the next Steam update.

2. have some new artifacts (like the tome of donors), new map adjustments (like moving dungeon sections) and the groundwork for a revised team (crowd) mode. Soon you will be able to play ADOM as a team on Steam (hey, the Mad Minstrel seems to be active here ;-) allowing you to trade items, chat, exchange power and more.

3. are adding tons of new graphics (final female versions of all monsters concerned, e.g. no more female bearded black wizards ;-), new achievement icons and lots of detail refinements).

Besides that we already have fixed a ton of details (currently about 30 issues total addressed).

We intend to do a closed prerelease test to see how people like the new character generation process and then (when all the graphical work has been done, too) will provide a Steam beta version. If that works out well, too, we will ASAP release a new Steam version.

Next up then: Lots of fiddling with the mouse interface, a more guided access to the background story and lots of new content!

We'll keep you updated as we progress.

Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM R64 (version 2.0.3) officially released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just officially released ADOM R64 (version 2.0.3) on Steam. This is another important step forward by introducing three major additions:

1. You now can play ADOM offline. No more internet connection required.
2. You now can select star signs freely.
3. Keyboard commands have been greatly simplified. You now can play the game by memorizing the cursor key/numpad commands in addition to ENTER (for the context actions), minus ('-') for the exploration command and '?' for the online help ;-) 

There's a lot more fine-tuning and you can find all the details of this exciting  new release at http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2015/12/adom-deluxe-r64-version-203-released-on.html

And now enjoy the game ;-)
Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM R64 available as beta access
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just released a beta version of ADOM R64 on Steam. Currently included are the following most important changes:

1. We have [b]fixed more potential crash sources[/b]. Crashes by now seem to happen on a limited number of systems (but still have been there) - so if you are a victim of crashes please try out the beta version if you don't mind being a tester.

2. ADOM R64 should now be playable in [b]offline mode[/b] (prior versions required internet access to be played).

3. The "explore unknown areas" command (accessible by pressing '-' (minus)) has been enhanced to truly cover all areas and also search out item stacks.

4. The "use" command (accessible by pressing 'u') has been enhanced to handle items more intelligently.

Enhancements #3 and #4 are partial steps on our road to a much more simplified UI/UX. We are trying to reduce the number of keyboard commands new players will need to learn and my personal goal is to make them countable on one hand (except for the movement keys - but that should be trivial).

The [b]full list of changes[/b] can be found here:
       http://www.adom.de/home/changelog.html

The instructions to access ADOM Beta can be found here:
       http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/p/adom-beta-steam.html

If you play the beta version and find problems please report them at
       http://www.adom.de/forums/project.php?projectid=2

And now have fun!

Thomas Biskup & Team ADOM

notes.title: ADOM R62 (2.0.1) released on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Due to certain sad and lamentable instabilities in our ADOM R61 (2.0.0) release we decided to quickly follow up with ADOM R62 (2.0.1).

For those plagued by bugs on Steam in the R61 (version 2.0.0) release we are happy to announce that

- Alt-tabbing and shift-tabbing no longer should cause any problems.

- There no longer should be any hangs when leaving the game unobserved in the background.

- Reading spellbooks no longer should cause any NotEye problems.
Right-clicking on altars no longer should cause problems.


We also already fine-tuned some minor functionalities. The most important additions are:

- 'u'se tool now is more intelligent: When you have no tool equipped it lets you select an item to use from your backpack (this is the first step to reduce the number of keys a new player will need to know - the second step with the next release will be to allow many uses, e.g. eating, drinking, etc. directly).

- The 'explore unknown areas' command (w?) now also is bound to '-' (minus) to make it much more accessible. I already have become addicted and also have noticed a couple of areas where it should be made more intelligent (e.g. when discovering monsters and items; also something to do for the next step).

- Additionally exploration mode now offers a wand of wishing with 42 wishes as people complained about our tough limit of 4. We live to please ;-)

As usual you can find the list of changes here: http://www.adom.de/home/changelog.html

The full blog announcement can be found here: http://www.ancientdomainsofmystery.com/2015/11/adom-r62-version-201-released-on-steam.html

In case you are more happy with R62 than with R61 we also would be happy if you adjust reviews :-)

Thanks and now go playing and enjoy the game!
